items.title: Jaylen Warren: Leader of Pittsburgh's backfield
items.text:
Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that he views Warren as "our featured player right now," Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Roman Wilson: Won't play Week 6 vs. Tampa Bay
items.text:
Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Wilson (finger) will not play against the Buccaneers on Sunday, Nick Farabaugh of SteelersNow.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Penix: Could be available to play Week 6
items.text:
The Falcons have optimism that Penix (ribs) will be able to play Sunday against the Bears, Jonathan Jones and Josh Kendall of The Athletic report.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Progressing in recovery
items.text:
Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Jackson is "definitely doing better" in his recovery from a sprained left ankle, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Not yet ready to practice
items.text:
Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Tyson (hamstring) is "progressing well" but isn't on track to return to practice this week, Jeff Nowak reports.
